items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I hit my teacher, Miss Itzel, with a stick.

ctx.x: What really happened - I used to hide under the bed. I don't know if I told you about this and I think it's a terrible thing that anybody would indoctrinate a black kid against what happened to them when they were in slavery, what happened to their parents when they were in slavery, because it affected me so when I was quite young. I was in the third grade, I remember. I usedto hide under the bed and listen to my great-grandparents talk about slaves and things. It infuriated me so that when I went to school I hit…
